message.content:
If you want **MSNBC/MS NOW live streaming online for free**, the most legitimate free option in the results is the **MS NOW app**, which lets you watch **live** and listen to **live audio 24/7**, but *live video* requires signing in with a **TV provider**.[5]

A few important points:
- **YouTube TV** offers **MS NOW** through a **free trial**, not permanently free.[6]
- The “free” streaming sites in the results advertise MSNBC/MS NOW live streams, but they are **third-party sites** rather than the official provider, so availability and legitimacy can vary.[1][2][4]
- If you just want to listen, **MS NOW audio** is available in the app without needing the same live-TV setup as the video stream.[5]
